findings.description: The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so it does not itself enforce encryption for objects written without explicit encryption settings.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL restricts access but does not ensure ledger exports are encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not enforce encryption of current or versioned objects at rest.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption; private ACLs and versioning do not enforce encryption for stored runbook objects or their versions.

This object specifies neither server-side encryption nor a KMS key, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The vendor roster is therefore not configured for encryption at rest.
